summary: Iteration 15 - New Features Testing PASSED. All new features working correctly: 1) Public Results page at /results displays 'Verified AI Pick Results' with stat cards (Wins=19, Losses=20, Win Rate=48.7%, Streak=2 lost), Overall Record bar, Recent Picks list with WIN/LOSS outcomes, and CTAs linking to /auth. 2) GET /api/picks-performance is public (no auth required), returns won, lost, win_rate, current_streak, streak_type, recent_picks. 3) POST /api/usage/extend requires auth and returns 400 if share extension already used. 4) Landing page has 'View All Results' button that navigates to /results. 5) Dashboard WinStreakBanner not rendered (correct - requires streak >= 3 and streak_type === 'won', current is 2 lost). 6) Dashboard FreeTrialExtension not visible for new free users (correct - shows only when analyses_remaining <= 1). 7) Free user dashboard shows usage bar with progress dots, '5 of 5 free analyses remaining', and upgrade CTAs.

context_for_next_testing_agent: New features verified in iteration 15: 1) Public Results page at /results shows AI pick stats (19W-20L-48.7%, streak=2 lost), 2) GET /api/picks-performance is public endpoint returning won/lost/win_rate/current_streak/streak_type/recent_picks, 3) POST /api/usage/extend grants 3 bonus analyses one-time (returns 400 on second use), 4) Landing page has 'View All Results' button linking to /results, 5) WinStreakBanner only shows when streak >= 3 and won (not visible currently since streak is 2 lost), 6) FreeTrialExtension only shows when analyses_remaining <= 1 (not visible for new users with 5 remaining).
